## Testing (required)

A PR must be tested in game before it is opened. PRs without screenshots will not be reviewed.

- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes
- [ ] Tested in game on a real Bedrock client
- [ ] Screenshots of every feature or fix are attached below
- [ ] Changes to existing content include **before and after** screenshots

**Tested with:**

- Server software and version:
- Geyser version:
- Content plugin (Nexo / ItemsAdder / other) and version:
- Bedrock client version and device:
